history.summary: Compact 1130sqft 3BR at $1.82M, 180m from Sengkang MRT and bus interchange — unbeatable connectivity in the batch. $1610 psf is ~11% below the La Fiesta median of $1808, and the development has the deepest transaction history here (190 txns) at 6.73%/yr. Some stacks sit close to the LRT (noise); early defects were reportedly resolved.
history.rating_rationale: Location is the thesis: 2-minute walk to Sengkang MRT interchange and mall is a permanent liquidity and rental magnet. ~11% below-median PSF, 190 transactions (highest in batch = strong exit confidence), 6.73%/yr resale CAGR, and a sub-$1.85M price all support a Buy. The 1130sqft layout is efficient but tight for a 3BR, and LRT-proximate stacks carry noise — target stacks facing away from the track. Lowest-risk exit in the D19 group.
red_flags: LRT runs close to some stacks (noise, privacy)
1130sqft is compact for a 3BR; less family-friendly than peers
catalysts: 180m to Sengkang MRT interchange + mall — top-tier connectivity
Deepest transaction liquidity in the batch (190 URA txns)
Punggol Digital District / CRL strengthening D19 demand

history.summary: A genuinely under-priced 3BR in a deep, liquid OCR project right beside Sengkang/Buangkok MRT — the cheapness checks out against real recent transactions, and OCR is the strongest forward-return region in the v3.4 priors.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,610 psf sits below La Fiesta's actual last-12-month 3BR transaction band of $1,724-1,882 psf (avg ~1,724-1,882) and below the cohort, supporting the algo's -7.6% age-adj and -5.4% vs-cohort premiums. Unlike the thin-data names in this batch, the cheapness rests on a deep base: 190 appreciation txns and 10 same-size cohort txns, so the discount is real rather than a 1-comparable quirk. D19/OCR realizes ~+4.0% forward (the best region in the priors), and the unit has fully sheltered 3-min MRT access plus full facilities. Trailing 6.7% CAGR is treated as story only. Score 1000=790.
red_flags: 99-yr leasehold from 2012 — ~85 yrs left, no freehold cushion (though FH is not a forward edge anyway)
Early construction defects historically (believed resolved) and recurring resident complaints about estate management/security
Sengkang has heavy future condo supply that can cap appreciation and rental pricing power
catalysts: Direct sheltered ~3-min walk to Sengkang/Buangkok MRT and Compass One / Sengkang Grand mall ecosystem
Asking below verified recent resale band gives margin of safety at entry
OCR forward-return premium per backtest priors (~+4.0%)

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Family-sized 3BR near MRT and malls rents well to HDB-upgrader-adjacent and expat-lite tenant pool; large 810-unit project keeps rental comps liquid, though abundant nearby supply limits yield upside.
